title: A bare SUM inside ADDCOLUMNS ignores the current row and gives the grand total on every row

source.quote: Remember: the row context iterates, it does not filter.
source.supports: a row context does not filter, so SUM sees the whole Sales table on every row

source.quote: you need to invoke context transition to generate a filter
source.supports: the example's '@Quantity Wrong' column, SUM ( Sales[Quantity] ) with no CALCULATE, shows the same total (140,180) on every row

derivation: The three colors are Red, Blue, Green. No CALCULATE, so no context transition: SUM ( Sales[Quantity] ) is evaluated in the empty filter context on every row: 1 + 2 + 1 + 5 + 2 + 3 + 1 = 15.
